title: Cozy House Letter Song
hook: Comfort works when the room stays safe to use.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: warm 3D home storybook, tidy rooms, familiar household objects, simple segmentation-friendly scenes; visual identity: Cozy House Letter Song

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child noticing what makes a home comfortably usable
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Cozy House Letter Song about comfort systems rather than decoration: warmth, soft support, light, clean textiles, food storage, airflow and quiet order create comfort while hazards stay controlled.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child learns cozy does not mean cluttered, overheated, or filled with loose soft items in every sleep context.
